name: out-suggested-orders
why: His 13 Nov 2026 strategy, slice 5: a named restaurant gets 2 or 3 suggested orders from what it actually serves, one reason each tied to his day, and an offer to mark the meal out. Never a dish that clashes with a restriction, never 'it is nut-free', never a precise calorie figure (the app logs a meal out as a range, his ruling 'A range').
messages: I'm going to an Italian restaurant on Friday night, what should I order?
